CREATE TABLE ev(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, at TEXT, g TEXT, v INT, n INT)
CREATE TABLE w(g TEXT PRIMARY KEY, m INT) WITHOUT ROWID
INSERT INTO w VALUES ('a', 1), ('b', 2), ('d', 3)
SELECT id, sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY id), lag(v + 1) OVER (ORDER BY date(at), id), coalesce(lag(v + 1) OVER (ORDER BY date(at), id), 0) FROM ev
SELECT id FROM ev ORDER BY sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY id), lag(v + 1) OVER (ORDER BY date(at), id), typeof(lag(v + 1) OVER (ORDER BY date(at), id)) LIMIT 5

SELECT 1 FROM ev ORDER BY NULL, ntile(1) OVER (ORDER BY ev.rowid), lag('x') OVER (ORDER BY v, strftime(v, 1.0), ev.rowid DESC), typeof(lag('x') OVER (ORDER BY v, strftime(v, 1.0), ev.rowid DESC)) LIMIT 2 OFFSET 0
SELECT id, rank() OVER (ORDER BY g), lead(v) OVER (PARTITION BY date(at) ORDER BY id), lead(v) OVER (PARTITION BY date(at) ORDER BY id) - v FROM ev

SELECT id, count(*) OVER (), first_value(v + 1) OVER (ORDER BY date(at), id), nth_value(v + 1, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date(at), id), abs(first_value(v + 1) OVER (ORDER BY date(at), id)), nth_value(v + 1, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date(at), id) + 1 FROM ev
SELECT id, sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY id), first_value(random()) OVER (ORDER BY v, id) = first_value(random()) OVER (ORDER BY v, id) FROM ev
SELECT id, sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY id), json_group_array(date(at)) OVER (ORDER BY v, id), json_group_array(date(at)) OVER (ORDER BY v, id) || 'x' FROM ev

SELECT id, sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY id), count(date(at)) FILTER (WHERE date(at) > '2026-01-01') OVER (ORDER BY g, id), count(date(at)) FILTER (WHERE date(at) > '2026-01-01') OVER (ORDER BY g, id) * 2 FROM ev
SELECT g, sum(count(*)) OVER (ORDER BY g), lag(sum(v)) OVER (ORDER BY date(max(at)), g), coalesce(lag(sum(v)) OVER (ORDER BY date(max(at)), g), 0) FROM ev GROUP BY g
SELECT s.x, s.y FROM (SELECT lag(v) OVER (ORDER BY date(at), id) AS x, coalesce(lag(v) OVER (ORDER BY date(at), id), 0) AS y, sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS z FROM ev) AS s WHERE s.z > 5

SELECT v, typeof(avg(max(n) + 1) OVER (ORDER BY lower(coalesce(v, '-')), min(id) RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)), total(sum(v)) FILTER (WHERE count(*) > 2) OVER wn, dense_rank() OVER wn FROM ev GROUP BY v WINDOW wn AS (ORDER BY lower(coalesce(v, '-')), min(id))

SELECT ev.id, w.m, coalesce(last_value(ev.g) OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%d', ev.at) ORDER BY w.m % 3, ev.id, w.m DESC), 0), total(ev.v + 1) OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%d', ev.at) ORDER BY w.m % 3, ev.id, w.m DESC) = group_concat('z' || ev.g) OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%d', ev.at) ORDER BY w.m % 3, ev.id, w.m DESC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM ev JOIN w ON w.g = ev.g

SELECT ev.id, w.m, lag(ev.v, 2, coalesce(ev.v, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY lower(ev.g), ev.id, w.m), CASE WHEN lag(ev.id + 1) OVER (ORDER BY lower(ev.g), ev.id, w.m) IS NULL THEN 'none' ELSE dense_rank() OVER wn END, coalesce(lag(ev.id + 1) OVER (ORDER BY lower(ev.g), ev.id, w.m), 0) FROM ev LEFT JOIN w ON w.g = ev.g WINDOW wn AS (PARTITION BY strftime('%d', ev.at) ORDER BY w.m, w.m)

SELECT ev.id, w.m, CASE WHEN total((w.m % 4)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%d', ev.at), ev.id DESC, w.m DESC GROUPS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) IS NULL THEN 'none' ELSE percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%d', ev.at), ev.id DESC, w.m DESC) END, count(ev.v) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%d', ev.at), ev.id DESC, w.m DESC GROUPS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM ev FULL JOIN w ON w.g = ev.g
SELECT date(at), lag(count(*) + 10, 0) OVER (ORDER BY min(id), min(id), min(id)), typeof(lag(count(*) + 10, 0) OVER (ORDER BY min(id), min(id), min(id))) FROM ev GROUP BY date(at)

SELECT g, sum(max(n) + 1) OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%d', max(at)), lower(coalesce(g, '-')) ORDER BY coalesce(g, '-'), min(id) GROUPS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) = sum(max(n) + 1) OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%d', max(at)), lower(coalesce(g, '-')) ORDER BY coalesce(g, '-'), min(id) GROUPS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM ev GROUP BY g

SELECT coalesce(sum(v) OVER (PARTITION BY lower(at) ORDER BY date(at)), 0), nth_value(CASE WHEN id > 2 THEN v ELSE g END, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%d', at) ORDER BY at, id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND CURRENT ROW) FROM ev

SELECT id, last_value(date(at)) OVER (ORDER BY n DESC, v % 3, id GROUPS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND 1 FOLLOWING EXCLUDE TIES) FROM ev ORDER BY typeof(nth_value(n + 1, 1) OVER (ORDER BY n DESC, v % 3, id RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)), nth_value(n + 1, 1) OVER (ORDER BY n DESC, v % 3, id RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING), id LIMIT 3

SELECT ev.id, w.m, typeof(sum((ev.v % 4)) FILTER (WHERE ev.id > 4) OVER (ORDER BY lower(ev.g) DESC, ev.v % 3 DESC, ev.id, w.m GROUPS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING EXCLUDE CURRENT ROW)), typeof(lead(coalesce(ev.v, -3), 1, -9) OVER wn), quote(total(w.m) OVER (PARTITION BY lower(w.g), w.m ORDER BY lower(w.g), ev.g, ev.id, w.m)) || '|' || quote(lead(w.m) OVER wn) FROM ev JOIN w WINDOW wn AS (ORDER BY lower(ev.g) DESC, ev.v % 3 DESC, ev.id, w.m)

SELECT ev.id, w.m, max(ev.id) OVER (PARTITION BY lower(ev.g), ev.v % 3 ORDER BY ev.id, w.m RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE NO OTHERS), max(ev.id) OVER (PARTITION BY lower(ev.g), ev.v % 3 ORDER BY ev.id, w.m RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE NO OTHERS) FROM ev FULL JOIN w ON w.g = ev.g

SELECT ev.id, w.m, typeof(cume_dist() OVER (PARTITION BY lower(w.g))), typeof(ntile(1) OVER (PARTITION BY w.g ORDER BY lower(w.g), ev.id, w.m)), coalesce(group_concat('z' || ev.g) OVER (PARTITION BY w.g ORDER BY lower(w.g), ev.id, w.m), 0) FROM ev LEFT JOIN w ON w.g = ev.g

SELECT ev.id, w.m, lead(coalesce(w.m, -3), 2) OVER wn, max(ev.id) OVER wn = min(ev.v) OVER wn, first_value(w.g) OVER wn FROM ev FULL JOIN w ON w.g = ev.g WINDOW wn AS (PARTITION BY lower(w.g), w.m ORDER BY ev.id, w.m)

SELECT date(at), avg(count(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY count(*) % 3, coalesce(date(at), '-') ORDER BY strftime('%d', max(at)), min(id), min(id)), typeof(rank() OVER (PARTITION BY count(*) % 3, coalesce(date(at), '-') ORDER BY strftime('%d', max(at)), min(id), min(id))) FROM ev GROUP BY date(at)

SELECT ev.id, w.m, nth_value(w.g, 3) OVER (PARTITION BY w.g, ev.v % 3 ORDER BY ev.id, w.m), typeof(count(w.m + 2) OVER (PARTITION BY w.g, ev.v % 3 ORDER BY ev.id, w.m ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND 1 FOLLOWING EXCLUDE GROUP)) FROM ev LEFT JOIN w ON w.m > ev.n

SELECT cume_dist() OVER (ORDER BY v % 3, date(at) DESC NULLS FIRST) = sum(id) OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%d', at) ORDER BY lower(g), id), typeof(dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%d', at) ORDER BY lower(g), id)), avg((n % 4)) OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%d', at) ORDER BY lower(g), id RANGE BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND CURRENT ROW), avg((v % 4)) FILTER (WHERE n > 0) OVER (ORDER BY v % 3, date(at) DESC NULLS FIRST RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE TIES) FROM ev WHERE date(at) > '2026-01-01'
SELECT coalesce(min(n) OVER (PARTITION BY v, date(at) ORDER BY v, id), 0) FROM ev

SELECT g, first_value(sum(v)) OVER (PARTITION BY max(n), lower(coalesce(g, '-')) ORDER BY lower(coalesce(g, '-')), sum(v), min(id) GROUPS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING EXCLUDE TIES), row_number() OVER wn, first_value(sum(v)) OVER (PARTITION BY max(n), lower(coalesce(g, '-')) ORDER BY lower(coalesce(g, '-')), sum(v), min(id) GROUPS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING EXCLUDE TIES) FROM ev GROUP BY g WINDOW wn AS (PARTITION BY max(n), lower(coalesce(g, '-')) ORDER BY lower(coalesce(g, '-')), sum(v), min(id))
SELECT (nth_value(v + 1, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%d', at), n ORDER BY id)) IS id FROM ev

SELECT max(c0), count(*) FROM (SELECT id, dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY id % 3 ORDER BY lower(at), id) AS c0, total((n % 4)) OVER (PARTITION BY id % 3 ORDER BY lower(at), id) AS c1, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY id % 3 ORDER BY lower(at), id) AS c2 FROM ev) AS s
SELECT v, cume_dist() OVER (ORDER BY lower(coalesce(v, '-'))), percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY lower(coalesce(v, '-'))), cume_dist() OVER (ORDER BY lower(coalesce(v, '-'))) FROM ev GROUP BY v
SELECT (percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY n, id DESC)) IS at, coalesce(rank() OVER (ORDER BY n, id DESC), 0) FROM ev

SELECT id, c0 FROM (SELECT id, nth_value(v + 10, 3) OVER (ORDER BY lower(g) ASC NULLS LAST, lower(at), id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING EXCLUDE GROUP) AS c0 FROM ev) AS s WHERE c0 IS NOT NULL

SELECT (max(CASE WHEN v > 2 THEN v ELSE g END) OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY id DESC)) IS date(at), coalesce(max(CASE WHEN v > 2 THEN v ELSE g END) OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY id DESC), 0), max(CASE WHEN v > 2 THEN v ELSE g END) OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY id DESC), max(v + 10) OVER (ORDER BY id, date(at) GROUPS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM ev WHERE v > 0

WITH s AS (SELECT id, coalesce(count('x') OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%d', at) ORDER BY id, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS c0, count('x') OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%d', at) ORDER BY id, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS c1 FROM ev) SELECT a.id, a.c0, b.c0 FROM s AS a JOIN s AS b ON b.id = a.id + 1
SELECT last_value(at) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%d', at), n DESC NULLS FIRST, id DESC) FROM (SELECT * FROM ev WHERE id <> 3) AS ev
SELECT ev.id, w.m, typeof(min(w.m) FILTER (WHERE ev.v > 2) OVER wn) FROM ev LEFT JOIN w ON w.g = ev.g WINDOW wn AS (PARTITION BY ev.id, w.g ORDER BY ev.g DESC, date(ev.at), ev.id, w.m DESC)

SELECT g, CASE WHEN min(min(id)) OVER (ORDER BY lower(coalesce(g, '-')) GROUPS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE GROUP) IS NULL THEN 'none' ELSE min(min(id)) OVER (ORDER BY lower(coalesce(g, '-')) GROUPS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE GROUP) END, min(min(id)) OVER (ORDER BY lower(coalesce(g, '-')) GROUPS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE GROUP) = nth_value(date(max(at)), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY lower(coalesce(g, '-')) ORDER BY min(id) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE GROUP) FROM ev GROUP BY g

SELECT count(date(at)) OVER wn = count(date(at)) OVER wn, count(date(at)) OVER wn, typeof(sum(id) OVER (ORDER BY id DESC GROUPS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE TIES)), (min(n) OVER wn) IS id FROM ev WINDOW wn AS (ORDER BY id DESC)

SELECT typeof(cume_dist() OVER (PARTITION BY id)), total((v % 4)) OVER (PARTITION BY v, v ORDER BY lower(g) DESC NULLS FIRST), percent_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY id) FROM (SELECT * FROM ev WHERE id <> 3) AS ev

WITH s AS (SELECT id, avg(v) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%d', at)) = rank() OVER () AS c0, avg(n + 1) OVER (RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS c1, coalesce(rank() OVER (), 0) AS c2 FROM ev) SELECT a.id, a.c0, b.c0 FROM s AS a JOIN s AS b ON b.id = a.id + 1

SELECT avg(id) OVER (ORDER BY id GROUPS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING), total((id % 4)) OVER (RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE GROUP), cume_dist() OVER (), coalesce(percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY at, id DESC), 0) FROM ev WHERE date(at) > '2026-01-01'

SELECT id, quote(lag(id, 1, -9) OVER (PARTITION BY v, date(at) ORDER BY g, id)) || '|' || quote(lead(id, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY lower(g) ORDER BY lower(at) ASC NULLS LAST, id)), lead(at, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY v, date(at) ORDER BY g, id) = cume_dist() OVER (PARTITION BY v, date(at) ORDER BY g, id) FROM ev ORDER BY count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY lower(g) ORDER BY lower(at) ASC NULLS LAST, id GROUPS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE GROUP) DESC, id LIMIT 3
SELECT g, lag(min(id), 2) OVER (PARTITION BY sum(v) % 3, min(id) ORDER BY min(id)), dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY sum(v) % 3, min(id) ORDER BY min(id)) FROM ev GROUP BY g

SELECT g, percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY date(max(at))) = percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY date(max(at))), percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY date(max(at))) = first_value(coalesce(sum(v), 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY count(*) ORDER BY count(*) % 3, min(id)), CASE WHEN percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY date(max(at))) IS NULL THEN 'none' ELSE cume_dist() OVER (PARTITION BY count(*) ORDER BY count(*) % 3, min(id)) END FROM ev GROUP BY g
SELECT typeof(dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY id DESC)), lag('x', 2) OVER (ORDER BY id DESC) FROM ev
SELECT ntile(50) OVER wn, typeof(ntile(50) OVER wn), typeof(ntile(50) OVER wn), ntile(50) OVER wn FROM ev WINDOW wn AS (ORDER BY id, id DESC)

SELECT g, nth_value(7, 1) OVER (ORDER BY max(n), lower(coalesce(g, '-')), min(id) GROUPS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE NO OTHERS) = nth_value(7, 1) OVER (ORDER BY max(n), lower(coalesce(g, '-')), min(id) GROUPS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE NO OTHERS) FROM ev GROUP BY g HAVING count(*) > 1
SELECT ev.id, w.m, cume_dist() OVER (ORDER BY w.m), (cume_dist() OVER (ORDER BY w.m)) IS ev.id FROM ev LEFT JOIN w ON w.m > ev.n

SELECT count(n) OVER (PARTITION BY at, n ORDER BY v, lower(at), id DESC RANGE BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING), count(n) OVER (PARTITION BY at, n ORDER BY v, lower(at), id DESC RANGE BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) = count(n) OVER (PARTITION BY at, n ORDER BY v, lower(at), id DESC RANGE BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING), CASE WHEN sum(id) FILTER (WHERE n > 4) OVER (PARTITION BY at, n ORDER BY v, lower(at), id DESC GROUPS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE CURRENT ROW) IS NULL THEN 'none' ELSE rank() OVER (PARTITION BY at, n ORDER BY v, lower(at), id DESC) END, (rank() OVER (PARTITION BY at, n ORDER BY v, lower(at), id DESC)) IS v FROM ev WHERE v > 0
SELECT ev.id, w.m, min(ev.g) OVER (ORDER BY ev.v, ev.v % 3, ev.id, w.m RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM ev LEFT JOIN w ON w.m > ev.n

SELECT id, rank() OVER (ORDER BY id), typeof(rank() OVER (ORDER BY id)) FROM ev ORDER BY percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY id) = rank() OVER (ORDER BY id), CASE WHEN dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY id) IS NULL THEN 'none' ELSE percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY id) END, (avg(v + 1) FILTER (WHERE v > 4) OVER (ORDER BY id RANGE BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE NO OTHERS)) IS date(at), id LIMIT 3

SELECT id, nth_value(id + 1, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY date(at), n % 3 ORDER BY id DESC), cume_dist() OVER (PARTITION BY lower(at) ORDER BY id, lower(at), id) FROM ev ORDER BY nth_value(v, 3) OVER (PARTITION BY date(at), n % 3 ORDER BY id DESC), max(coalesce(id, -3)) OVER (PARTITION BY lower(at) ORDER BY id, lower(at), id ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE GROUP) DESC, first_value(date(at)) OVER (PARTITION BY lower(at) ORDER BY id, lower(at), id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE CURRENT ROW) = min(CASE WHEN v > 2 THEN id ELSE at END) OVER (PARTITION BY date(at), n % 3 ORDER BY id DESC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE GROUP) DESC, id

SELECT last_value(v) OVER (ORDER BY id ASC NULLS LAST, strftime('%d', at), id DESC GROUPS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE TIES), CASE WHEN count(coalesce(v, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY v % 3 ORDER BY lower(at)) IS NULL THEN 'none' ELSE count(coalesce(v, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY v % 3 ORDER BY lower(at)) END FROM ev

SELECT g, first_value(sum(v)) OVER (ORDER BY min(id)), quote(count(*) FILTER (WHERE min(id) > 0) OVER (PARTITION BY min(id) % 3 ORDER BY coalesce(g, '-'), max(n), min(id))) || '|' || quote(count(*) FILTER (WHERE min(id) > 0) OVER (PARTITION BY min(id) % 3 ORDER BY coalesce(g, '-'), max(n), min(id))) FROM ev GROUP BY g HAVING count(*) > 1

SELECT id, nth_value(id, 3) OVER (PARTITION BY lower(at), v ORDER BY v, id RANGE BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE NO OTHERS), nth_value(id, 3) OVER (PARTITION BY lower(at), v ORDER BY v, id RANGE BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE NO OTHERS) FROM ev ORDER BY sum(id) OVER (PARTITION BY date(at) ORDER BY n % 3, id DESC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) = max(CASE WHEN id > 2 THEN id ELSE g END) OVER (PARTITION BY date(at) ORDER BY n % 3, id DESC GROUPS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE NO OTHERS), count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY lower(at), v ORDER BY v, id), id LIMIT 3

SELECT ev.id, w.m, quote(sum((ev.v % 4)) OVER (ORDER BY date(ev.at), date(ev.at), ev.id, w.m DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING EXCLUDE CURRENT ROW)) || '|' || quote(ntile(1) OVER (ORDER BY date(ev.at), date(ev.at), ev.id, w.m DESC)), ntile(1) OVER (ORDER BY date(ev.at), date(ev.at), ev.id, w.m DESC) = sum((ev.v % 4)) OVER (ORDER BY date(ev.at), date(ev.at), ev.id, w.m DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING EXCLUDE CURRENT ROW) FROM ev JOIN w ON w.g = ev.g

SELECT date(at), sum(max(n)) OVER (PARTITION BY max(n) ORDER BY coalesce(date(at), '-'), min(id) RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING), count(coalesce(date(at), '-')) OVER (PARTITION BY min(id), strftime('%d', max(at)) ORDER BY min(id) % 3, min(id), min(id) RANGE BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING), percent_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY max(n) ORDER BY coalesce(date(at), '-'), min(id)) FROM ev GROUP BY date(at)

SELECT id, c0 FROM (SELECT id, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY v, at) AS c0, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY v, at) AS c1, coalesce(dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY v, at), 0) AS c2, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY v, at) AS c3 FROM ev) AS s

SELECT coalesce(lead(n) OVER (ORDER BY id), 0), coalesce(lead(v, 1, -9) OVER (ORDER BY id), 0), coalesce(lead(n) OVER (ORDER BY id), 0), typeof(count(NULL) OVER (ORDER BY id GROUPS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING EXCLUDE NO OTHERS)) FROM ev WHERE date(at) > '2026-01-01'

SELECT date(at), min(count(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY sum(v), date(max(at)) ORDER BY sum(v), lower(coalesce(date(at), '-')) RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM ev GROUP BY date(at)
SELECT coalesce(dense_rank() OVER wn, 0) FROM ev WHERE date(at) > '2026-01-01' WINDOW wn AS (PARTITION BY lower(at), g ORDER BY strftime('%d', at), id)
SELECT avg(n) OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY id, id DESC), avg(n) OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY id, id DESC) FROM ev

SELECT date(at), first_value(count(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY lower(coalesce(date(at), '-')), sum(v) ORDER BY date(max(at)), min(id) GROUPS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE TIES), lag(date(max(at)), 0) OVER (PARTITION BY count(*) % 3, lower(coalesce(date(at), '-')) ORDER BY strftime('%d', max(at)), count(*), min(id)), (first_value(count(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY lower(coalesce(date(at), '-')), sum(v) ORDER BY date(max(at)), min(id) GROUPS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE TIES)) IS 7 FROM ev GROUP BY date(at)

SELECT rank() OVER (PARTITION BY lower(at)), coalesce(max(date(at)) OVER (PARTITION BY lower(at) RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE GROUP), 0), CASE WHEN rank() OVER (PARTITION BY lower(at)) IS NULL THEN 'none' ELSE cume_dist() OVER (ORDER BY lower(g), id DESC) END FROM (SELECT id, at, g, v, n FROM ev UNION ALL SELECT id + 100, at, g, n, v FROM ev) AS ev WHERE v > 0
SELECT count(date(at)) OVER (PARTITION BY date(at), lower(at) ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING EXCLUDE TIES), group_concat('z' || at) OVER (ORDER BY v, id) FROM ev

SELECT date(at), total((sum(v) % 4)) FILTER (WHERE count(*) > 4) OVER (PARTITION BY coalesce(date(at), '-') ORDER BY coalesce(date(at), '-'), lower(coalesce(date(at), '-')), min(id)) FROM ev GROUP BY date(at)

SELECT CASE WHEN min(n) OVER (PARTITION BY v, v ORDER BY id DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING EXCLUDE GROUP) IS NULL THEN 'none' ELSE first_value(7) OVER (ORDER BY lower(g), id GROUPS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND 2 FOLLOWING EXCLUDE CURRENT ROW) END, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY v, v ORDER BY id DESC) FROM (SELECT * FROM ev WHERE id <> 3) AS ev
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY id DESC) = rank() OVER (ORDER BY id DESC) FROM ev

SELECT typeof(dense_rank() OVER wn), CASE WHEN rank() OVER wn IS NULL THEN 'none' ELSE min(v + 1) FILTER (WHERE id > 4) OVER (PARTITION BY date(at) ORDER BY lower(g) RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) END, CASE WHEN sum(n + 1) OVER wn IS NULL THEN 'none' ELSE dense_rank() OVER wn END, dense_rank() OVER wn FROM ev WHERE v > 0 WINDOW wn AS (PARTITION BY date(at) ORDER BY lower(g))
SELECT ev.id, w.m, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY lower(w.g)), rank() OVER (PARTITION BY lower(w.g)), rank() OVER (PARTITION BY lower(w.g)) FROM ev LEFT JOIN w ON w.g = ev.g
SELECT v, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sum(v) > 0) OVER (ORDER BY lower(coalesce(v, '-')) GROUPS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING EXCLUDE GROUP) FROM ev GROUP BY v HAVING count(*) > 1

SELECT coalesce(percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY lower(g)), 0), count(*) OVER (ORDER BY lower(g)) = sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY lower(g) GROUPS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING EXCLUDE TIES), sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY lower(g) GROUPS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING EXCLUDE TIES) FROM ev WHERE v > 0

SELECT typeof(cume_dist() OVER (PARTITION BY id, strftime('%d', at) ORDER BY g DESC)), cume_dist() OVER (PARTITION BY id, strftime('%d', at) ORDER BY g DESC), cume_dist() OVER (PARTITION BY id, strftime('%d', at) ORDER BY g DESC) FROM ev WHERE v > 0

SELECT avg(n) FILTER (WHERE id > 0) OVER (PARTITION BY at, strftime('%d', at) ORDER BY lower(at), id DESC ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND 2 FOLLOWING), typeof(lead(id, 2) OVER (ORDER BY id DESC)), CASE WHEN percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY id DESC) IS NULL THEN 'none' ELSE last_value(id) OVER (ORDER BY id DESC GROUPS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE CURRENT ROW) END, first_value(at) OVER (PARTITION BY at, strftime('%d', at) ORDER BY lower(at), id DESC GROUPS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE NO OTHERS) FROM ev WHERE v > 0

SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY v % 3, v ORDER BY n % 3 DESC, id DESC RANGE BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE TIES) IS NULL THEN 'none' ELSE count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY v % 3, v ORDER BY n % 3 DESC, id DESC RANGE BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE TIES) END, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY v % 3, v ORDER BY n % 3 DESC, id DESC RANGE BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE TIES), count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY v % 3, v ORDER BY n % 3 DESC, id DESC RANGE BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE TIES), (row_number() OVER wn) IS v + 10 FROM ev WHERE v > 0 WINDOW wn AS (PARTITION BY v % 3, v ORDER BY n % 3 DESC, id DESC)

SELECT count(CASE WHEN id > 2 THEN v ELSE g END) OVER (PARTITION BY n % 3, lower(at) ORDER BY at ASC NULLS LAST, id, id), quote(nth_value(v, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY n % 3, lower(at) ORDER BY at ASC NULLS LAST, id, id GROUPS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING EXCLUDE CURRENT ROW)) || '|' || quote(total((v % 4)) OVER (PARTITION BY n % 3, lower(at) ORDER BY at ASC NULLS LAST, id, id)), quote(total((v % 4)) OVER (PARTITION BY n % 3, lower(at) ORDER BY at ASC NULLS LAST, id, id)) || '|' || quote(total((v % 4)) OVER (PARTITION BY n % 3, lower(at) ORDER BY at ASC NULLS LAST, id, id)) FROM ev WHERE v > 0

SELECT sum(id) FILTER (WHERE v > 0) OVER (PARTITION BY lower(g) ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING EXCLUDE GROUP), ntile(3) OVER (PARTITION BY at ORDER BY id DESC NULLS FIRST, v, id) FROM ev

SELECT min(n) OVER (ORDER BY lower(at)), min(CASE WHEN n > 2 THEN n ELSE g END) OVER (ORDER BY lower(at)), min(CASE WHEN n > 2 THEN n ELSE g END) OVER (ORDER BY lower(at)) = dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY lower(at)) FROM ev

SELECT v, avg(count(*) + 1) OVER (PARTITION BY max(n) ORDER BY sum(v) % 3, min(id) ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE GROUP), count(*) OVER (ORDER BY min(id) % 3, min(id), min(id)), avg(count(*) + 1) OVER (PARTITION BY max(n) ORDER BY sum(v) % 3, min(id) ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE GROUP) = avg(count(*) + 1) OVER (PARTITION BY max(n) ORDER BY sum(v) % 3, min(id) ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE GROUP) FROM ev GROUP BY v HAVING count(*) > 1

SELECT CASE WHEN last_value(at) OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%d', at) ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) IS NULL THEN 'none' ELSE last_value(id) OVER (ORDER BY g ASC NULLS LAST, id GROUPS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING EXCLUDE CURRENT ROW) END, quote(min(v) OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%d', at) ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE CURRENT ROW)) || '|' || quote(count('x') OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%d', at) ORDER BY id)), min(v) OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%d', at) ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE CURRENT ROW), (row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%d', at) ORDER BY id)) IS n FROM ev WHERE v > 0
SELECT dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY v), dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY v), (dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY v)) IS g, coalesce(dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY v), 0) FROM ev
